thread_title: S. moorei (Wilkerson's white Knight x bouquet)
breadcrumb: S. moorei (Wilkerson's white Knight x bouquet)

posts.body_html:
What happens when you cross two polyhybrids together? You get a wildcard of mixed up looking seedlings! I grew out a few hundred from these, and there were several that looked like each other, and many that were completely unexpected (ie. golden mooreis!).

Here's one seedling that I have my eye on. It didn't really do so well this year because it was heavily shaded by surrounding plants. I'll try to take better care of it next year, I bet this will look pretty spectacular when fully colored up with bigger traps:
